protocol.name: dbnn_w500_dt1ms_burn150_full_diag
protocol.architecture: One double-exponential filter per site, dense quadratic, linear sum, bias, event reset
protocol.pairing: Only diagonal mask differs; same initial physical state and seeded crops; identical train/validation/test protocol
protocol.initialization: Independent random weights; tau_rise=5ms, tau_decay=20ms, omega=.3, bias=-70mV, reset=(-55mV,15mV,10ms). No learned checkpoint.
protocol.window_sampling: Same seeded fit-case permutation, one crop per case/epoch; crop end uniformly sampled after500ms on native grid. 400/500ms arms share ends within each resolution. Each resolution uses exactly its external-baseline source panel.
protocol.initial_window_state: Zero local filter and reset states; no unobserved input or inherited teacher-reset state before the crop.
protocol.loss: Same balanced B2 loss: mean case-weighted masked voltage MSE + .1 first-difference MSE. Weights .3+.7/max(full-reference variance,.04), normalized over fit. Reference AP +/-10ms excluded. Burn applied equally to voltage and derivative terms.
protocol.optimizer: AdamW lr 0.003 / 0.0006000000000000001 refinement, wd 1e-6; cosine to .02 initial lr; clip1; EMA .995; FP32 IEEE
protocol.budget: Same case presentations / optimizer updates for the400/500ms arms within each resolution; corresponding resolution-specific fit panel sizes differ. Supervised physical time per update differs with window length.
protocol.selection: Full continuous 6s validation: pooled masked MSE + .02 mean normalized MSE with .04 variance floor + .05*(1-event F1 at +/-5ms). Best joint, best voltage and EMA candidates, reset grid calibrated on validation only.
protocol.reset_training: Fixed teacher reset during primary; validation-only reset calibration then refine using rebuilt teachers.
protocol.supervised_grid: Native1.0ms; held-out metrics on common1ms with reference AP +/-10ms excluded
